outcome: Transfusion of red cells or blood products
cohort: All women who gave birth in hospital in New South Wales or the major tertiary hospital in the neighboring Australian Capital Territory, Australia, between 2003 and 2019
finding: While infrequently used, IR in pregnant women was associated with a high level of adverse outcomes, reflecting its use in a high-risk population; however, for women with PAS undergoing planned cesarean with hysterectomy, IR may reduce bleeding.
mod_finding: For women with PAS undergoing planned cesarean with hysterectomy, most outcomes were similar for those receiving IR and those not receiving IR, but IR may reduce bleeding.
